title: Security Limits of Mining Before Validation in Nakamoto Consensus
summary: Mining before validation allows miners to extend a newly received block before completing its validity checks, giving them a head start in the race for the next block reward. This head start, however, comes with a security risk: rejecting one invalid block also discards the honest work built on it, an effect missed when validation is treated as instantaneous.
